tagline: Technology Executive | AI Engineering | Strategic Growth
profile: I’m a senior technology executive and hands-on engineer with nearly 20 years of experience building enterprise platforms, driving AI innovation, and leading technology transformation across government and industry. As a former DHS Chief Technology Officer and Chief AI Officer, I oversaw a $10 billion federal IT portfolio and delivered AI capabilities at enterprise scale. I combine engineering expertise with strategic growth, business development, and executive leadership to turn emerging technologies into measurable mission and business outcomes.
about: I believe effective technology leadership requires understanding the entire lifecycle of innovation: identifying the problem, designing the solution, building the technology, earning organizational adoption, and delivering measurable value. My career has let me approach that lifecycle as a software engineer, enterprise architect, federal CTO, AI executive, commercial solution engineer, and senior leader in a growing government technology company.

experience.title: Senior Vice President, Solution Engineering
experience.description: Led technology innovation, solution engineering, and AI transformation initiatives, combining hands-on technical leadership with business development, organizational growth, and strategic planning.
achievements: Architected and developed secure enterprise AI infrastructure, generative AI chatbots, and reusable data and AI platforms supporting internal operations and federal customer missions.
Developed tailored innovation plans with program delivery leadership, implementing mission-driven AI and automation technologies across approximately 50% of active projects within existing contracts.

Led company-wide AI literacy, upskilling, and reskilling initiatives, engaging more than 40% of the workforce and empowering employees to develop AI solutions that improved productivity and operational efficiency.

Architected and developed a proprietary AI-powered growth intelligence platform that automated opportunity discovery, evaluation, and proposal workflows, increasing the business development pipeline by 150% and reducing proposal development time by 60%.

Led technical growth and capture efforts that converted greenfield Data and AI opportunities into contract wins through customer engagement, technical demonstrations and challenges, proposal development, and oral presentations.

Supported Amivero’s successful acquisition by Xpect Solutions, a NewSpring Holdings platform company, in 2026 through executive management briefings and technology due diligence. Executed an AI strategy that strengthened the company’s capabilities and market differentiation.

focus.title: AI Engineering & Innovation
focus.body: I build AI systems that solve real problems. From generative AI and intelligent automation to secure enterprise platforms and responsible governance, I help organizations move beyond experimentation and make emerging technology practical, secure, and valuable.

focus.title: Technology Leadership & Transformation
focus.body: I’ve led engineering teams and enterprise transformation across government and industry. Successful transformation takes strong teams, a clear strategy, an understanding of organizational culture, and the ability to turn ambitious goals into executable plans.

focus.title: Strategic Growth & Business Development
focus.body: I connect technology with business strategy through federal sales, technical capture, customer engagement, and differentiated solutions. My experience includes opportunity shaping, executive management briefings, and M&A technology due diligence.

focus.title: Hands-On Engineering & Product Development
focus.body: I’ve never stopped being an engineer. I design architectures, write code, and build applications, exploring distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, AI orchestration, automation, and data platforms. Staying hands-on is part of being an effective technology leader.

journey: My career began in software engineering, driven by curiosity about how technology works and how it can make complicated things simpler. That curiosity grew into a career spanning federal technology leadership, enterprise modernization, commercial solution engineering, artificial intelligence, and business growth.

I served as CTO at ICE, worked in commercial solution engineering at Salesforce, and returned to DHS as Chief Technology and AI Officer. During my federal career, I modernized large-scale technology environments, established enterprise engineering capabilities, and advanced responsible AI adoption across complex government missions.

At Amivero, I combined hands-on engineering with technical strategy and business development: building secure AI capabilities, accelerating adoption across customer programs, and improving operational efficiency. I also participated in executive management briefings and technology due diligence supporting the company’s acquisition by Xpect Solutions in 2026.
Throughout these experiences, one thing has remained constant: I enjoy building things, solving difficult problems, and working with talented people to create something meaningful.

beyond: Technology has always been both my profession and my hobby. I’m a lifelong gamer, from classic RPGs and strategy games to first-person shooters and MMOs. I enjoy exploring game engines and how interactive experiences bring together technology, design, and storytelling. I also enjoy Dungeons & Dragons, 3D printing, home automation, electronics, and experimenting with development tools. Whether I’m building an AI application or a home project, I’m usually learning something new.

approach.title: Strategy Is Important. Execution Is Everything.
approach.body: A great technology strategy should be ambitious enough to change what’s possible and practical enough to implement. That requires understanding the technology, the organization, and the people who depend on the outcome. Sometimes the greatest improvements come from simplifying processes, reusing proven capabilities, or removing unnecessary complexity.

approach.title: Build Capabilities, Not Just Projects
approach.body: A successful project solves an immediate problem. A well-designed platform can help an organization solve an entire class of problems. I look for opportunities to create reusable AI infrastructure, development platforms, automation, and shared services, while being deliberate about where standardization creates value beyond the original use case.

approach.title: Make Innovation Accessible
approach.body: Transformation succeeds when people across an organization can participate. AI literacy, workforce development, and practical education help the people closest to a problem apply technology to their work. My role is to create the environment, tools, and guardrails that empower them to innovate responsibly.

approach.title: Connect Technology to Outcomes
approach.body: Complexity is never the objective. What matters is whether a solution improves customer experience, reduces operational friction, accelerates delivery, or creates new opportunities. Effective technology leaders move between vision, architecture, engineering, organizational change, and measurable results.

shortBio: Dave Larrimore is a technology executive, AI engineer, and former federal Chief Technology Officer with nearly 20 years of experience driving enterprise modernization, technology innovation, and business growth. He has served in senior leadership roles at DHS and ICE, overseeing large-scale technology portfolios and advancing enterprise cloud and AI capabilities. As Senior Vice President of Solution Engineering at Amivero, he combined hands-on AI engineering with technology strategy and business development. His work included enterprise AI platforms and proprietary automation that increased the business development pipeline by 150% and reduced proposal development time by 60%. He also supported executive management briefings and technology due diligence during Amivero’s acquisition by Xpect Solutions in 2026. Dave remains an active technologist, building software and exploring AI, product engineering, and organizational transformation.
